data.name: Gayelord
data.gender_notes: Gayelord is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old French 'gai', meaning joyful, and 'lord', a ruler or master. This name is a reminder of the joy and peace that comes from serving and obeying God. The name Gayelord carries the meaning “Lord of Joy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gayelord usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gayelord total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: גאיאלורד
in_hebrew.meaning: God is my helper, God is my mountain
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Gayelord in Hebrew can be broken down into two parts: 'Gayel' and 'ord'. 'Gayel' means 'God is my helper', while 'ord' means 'mountain'. Together, the name Gayelord means 'God is my helper, God is my mountain'. This name suggests that the person with this name trusts in God for support and protection, and sees God as a source of strength and stability.

in_greek.name: Γαϊέλωρδος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Gayelord in Greek is translated as 'Γαϊέλωρδος' (Gaiélōrdos). This name is derived from the Hebrew name 'גאיאלורד' (Gayelord), which means 'God is my helper, God is my mountain'. The name in Greek conveys the same meaning as in Hebrew, emphasizing the idea of God as a source of help and strength.

in_latin.name: Gaiēlōrdus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Gayelord in Latin is translated as 'Gaiēlōrdus'. This name is derived from the Hebrew name 'גאיאלורד' (Gayelord), which means 'God is my helper, God is my mountain'. The Latin name preserves the original meaning of the Hebrew name, emphasizing the idea of God as a source of help and support.

in_english.name: Gayelord
in_english.meaning: God helper, God is my mountain
in_english.long_meaning: The name Gayelord in English is the same as the original Hebrew name. It means 'God helper, God is my mountain'. This name conveys the idea of trusting in God for help and strength, and seeing God as a source of protection and stability.
